plugin.name: Project2DFX
ReplaceSmokeTrailWithBulletTrail.descrip: Gunshots leave bullet traces instead of smoke trails.
DrawDistance.description: How far objects and LOD models are drawn, independently of View Distance. Higher values fill the distant world but cost performance. 1 is the game’s own. Without Open Limit Adjuster, capped at 1.5.
DetailDistance.description: How far small objects and trees are drawn. Costs more performance than the draw distance. 1 is the game's own.
ShadowDistance.description: How far shadows under street lamps and traffic lights, and of cars and people, are drawn. 1 is the game's own.
DistantLights.description: Street lamps and other lights glow far across the city at night.
DistantLightShadows.description: Distant street lamps also light the ground under them with a soft pool of light. Requires the game's anti-aliasing (MSAA) to be off.
DistantTraffic.description: Cars and boats far away: only their lights, or the vehicles too.
DistantLightSize.description: Size of the distant lights. 1 is the size Project2DFX was made with.
Searchlights.description: Light cones of searchlights and street lamps.
ViewDistance.description: Extra outdoor view in metres: adds this amount to the weather’s far clip and fog start. 0 keeps the game’s view. Weather and time still blend normally. Interiors and cutscenes keep the game’s view. Without Open Limit Adjuster, capped at +500 m.
